title: Board Node Icon Inset Tuning
description: Reduce perceived whitespace around board node SVG icons by increasing fit_inset and clip_inset constants; align handle marker icon insets slightly.
summary: Reduced perceived icon padding: introduced NODE_ICON_FIT_INSET 0.82 (was 0.76) and NODE_ICON_CLIP_INSET 0.93 (was 0.88) so contain-fit uses more of the node while clip stays slightly outside the fitted rect. Handle marker icons use HANDLE_MARKER_ICON_FIT_INSET 0.68 and HANDLE_MARKER_ICON_CLIP_FRAC 0.87 (was 0.62 / 0.82). wasm32 check, wasm-pack release, Vitest 60 passed.
